newsitem.title: USA: Shop At Home Q3 revs rise 71 percent.
newsitem.headline: Shop At Home Q3 revs rise 71 percent.

text.p: Shop At Home Inc said Wednesday its revenues for the fiscal third quarter rose 71 percent from a year earlier, to $18.3 million.
The company, which specializes in the electronic interactive home shopping business, also said it projected net income to "improve substantially" from the year-earlier loss of $139,371.
It said it would release final figures for the quarter, begun January 1, by the end of April.
"The company continues to reach its quarterly revenue goals, and expects to reach its original earnings goals for the quarter and nine-month period," it said.
Shop At Home also said Tom Sutula had resigned as executive vice president and chief operating officer on March 21.
